description: Solo builder looking for teammates for Field Shift. I’m a biotech researcher working on domestic yak in Northern Pakistan, building a NASA-data tool that helps yak herders in Gilgit-Baltistan compare grazing-rotation strategies (which pasture to graze, rest, and when to move), with advice sent by SMS. Plan and requirements are ready. Looking for: Python/data, remote sensing (MODIS, NDVI), Streamlit or web frontend, and slides/design. Virtual, PKT.
